faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OAV Shirsa Support Staff posts?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications for the OAV Shirsa Support Staff posts is 12th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Support Staff at OAV Shirsa?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for Support Staff positions at Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Shirsa. These positions include Warden, Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper, Head Cook, and Assistant Cook.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for OAV Shirsa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the OAV Shirsa Support Staff Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post. For Warden, a B.A./B.Sc. with hostel management experience is required. For Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper, HSC is needed. Cooks require good cooking habits and hygiene knowledge.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Support Staff positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 6750 to Rs. 21175 per month, depending on the specific post. The Warden post offers the highest salary, while Assistant Cook offers the lowest.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for OAV Shirsa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the OAV Shirsa Support Staff Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application screening, and preference will be given to local candidates. Further details are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website, [email protected]. Please ensure you are downloading the correct form from a reliable source.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I attach with the application form?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational and experience certificates as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for OAV Shirsa?
faq.answer: The official contact email provided is [email protected]. For the official website, please refer to the official notification or search for Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Shirsa online.
